name: Intelligent Home
description: Status page (modules may push with a source name). The host pushes status to it (POST /ingest, bearer token). Maps no folders, holds no secrets. Secrets broker parked (off). Scheduler (MQTT, messages signed per module with module_keys) off unless enable_scheduler and the mqtt_* options are set.

ui.title: Intelligent Home
ui.purpose: Operate and inspect the add-on system, jobs, health, traces, settings, and usage.

name: Intelligent Home - Discord
description: Discord transport: holds the one bot token, reads each channel once (cursor + journal) and lets separate feature add-ons (ih_discord_house, ih_discord_shopping, ...) answer through a signed MQTT bus. No commands of its own since 0.7.0. Since 0.8.0 it can also administer channels for a module that is

ui.title: Discord Transport
ui.purpose: Connects the house add-ons to Discord.

name: Intelligent Home - Jobs
description: PARENT of the Jobs family. Lists and triggers the child job add-ons (Jobs - Backup, Jobs - Met Office), hosts plugins (app/plugins, option plugins) and still runs both jobs itself until you turn that off. All local details are options. DRY-RUN by default (logs what it would set); a job goes live per

ui.title: Jobs
ui.purpose: Coordinates the Jobs family and reports scheduled house job activity.

name: Intelligent Home - Jobs - Backup
description: Child of Intelligent Home - Jobs. Publishes the backup storage sensors (local disk, optional Google Drive). DRY-RUN by default. Registers with the parent.

ui.title: Jobs · Backup
ui.purpose: Reports how much backup space is used.

name: Intelligent Home - Jobs - Met Office
description: Child of Intelligent Home - Jobs. Met Office forecast sensors with a fallback to the Home Assistant weather entity. DRY-RUN by default. Registers with the parent.

ui.title: Jobs · Met Office
ui.purpose: Brings Met Office weather forecasts into the house.

name: Intelligent Home - Jobs - AI Trust Test
description: Child of Intelligent Home - Jobs. Monthly test of the outside AIs through the AI layer (fixed non-private questions, scored), then a review to-do. Shadow (dry) by default. Registers with the parent.

ui.title: Jobs · Trust
ui.purpose: Tests each month how good the outside AIs are.

name: Intelligent Home - Discord - House
description: House status commands (who is home, alarm, bins, heating, status of one device) as a module of the ih_discord transport. It talks to the transport over a signed MQTT bus and never holds a Discord token. All house details are options. SHADOW mode by default: it answers nothing, it only logs what it w

ui.title: Discord House
ui.purpose: Answers questions about the house in Discord.

name: Intelligent Home - Discord - Shopping
description: Shopping list commands (add items, shop checklist by aisle with tick reactions, got ...) as a module of the ih_discord transport. It talks to the transport over a signed MQTT bus and never holds a Discord token. All details are options. SHADOW mode by default: it answers nothing, it only logs what i

ui.title: Shopping Shortcut
ui.purpose: Set up and verify the iPhone Shortcut that adds items to the household shopping list.

name: Intelligent Home Games
description: Game activity facts feeds and chat message orchestrator. DRY-RUN by default.

ui.title: Games
ui.purpose: The single Games dashboard for player libraries, game progress, art, and research.

name: Intelligent Home - Discord - Task channels
description: One private Discord channel per task, as a module of the ih_discord transport: commands new / done / reopen / list in a commands channel, goal as channel topic, Work in Progress and Done categories, daily cleanup of old done channels. It asks the transport (signed MQTT bus) to administer channels an

ui.title: Discord Task Channels
ui.purpose: Gives each task its own Discord channel.

name: Intelligent Home - Orchestration - Inbox
description: Durable inbox for messages on chosen Discord channel keys, as a module of the ih_discord transport. It claims the channel keys you list, stores each message in a queue (7 days), reacts with an eye emoji so the sender knows it arrived, and never answers in the channel. Claude and workers read the que

ui.title: Orchestration Inbox
ui.purpose: Keeps a queue of requests waiting for Claude and other helpers.

name: Intelligent Home - Discord - AI Bot
description: Answers messages on chosen Discord channel keys with the Intelligent Home AI layer, as a module of the ih_discord transport. It sends the text of an allow-listed user's message to the AI layer over its local API and posts the reply back through the transport. It holds no Discord token and no AI key.

ui.title: Discord AI Bot
ui.purpose: Answers chosen Discord channels with the AI Layer.

name: Intelligent Home - Discord - Codex
description: A private Codex worker with filtered Home Assistant tools and a private IH code review branch, connected through the signed Discord transport.

ui.title: Discord Codex
ui.purpose: Runs Codex helper tasks that you request in Discord.

name: Intelligent Home - AI Layer
description: Routes an AI request (text + optional capability) to an AI provider and returns the answer. Providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, OpenAI, Pollinations, SerpApi, Serper, Grok, Claude) run inside this add-on; separate agent add-ons can still register with a signed registration (register_key). Remember

ui.title: AI Layer
ui.purpose: Sends questions to the best available AI and learns which one answers well.

name: Intelligent Home - AI Layer - Claude CLI Agent
description: Agent of Intelligent Home - AI Layer. Answers general questions and summarizes text by running the Claude Code CLI (print mode, all tools off) with a login that the owner creates inside this add-on. No API key. Weekly usage gate and daily cap. Text is scrubbed of personal data first. No Home Assista

ui.title: Claude CLI
ui.purpose: Lets the AI Layer ask Claude, using your own Claude login.

name: Intelligent Home - Cooking
description: Data owner for recipes and the meal plan, the recipes page (ingress), the weekly meal-vs-calendar check and the cook engine (oven steps, Discord, wall display row, HomePod). Cook control is DRY (logs only) until cook_mode is live and the other-controller guard passes. Maps no folders.

ui.title: Cooking
ui.purpose: Manage recipes, meal plans, and cooking sessions.

name: Intelligent Home - Brain
description: Serves House Brain notes to Claude over MCP and provides an admin-only ingress UI to browse, search and read notes.

ui.title: House Brain
ui.purpose: Search, browse, read, and map connections between House Brain notes.

name: Intelligent Home - Assistant - Personas
description: Personal assistant transport for several personas in one add-on: reads each person's private Discord messages through that persona's own bot, queues check-ins, and sends replies written elsewhere. Every persona has its own separate datastore. DRY-RUN by default.

ui.title: Assistant
ui.purpose: Looks after private chats and check-in messages for each person in the house.

name: Intelligent Home - Work
description: The work queue for Claude: one line of jobs (first in, first out) with leases, the pace gate (day and night levels) and a task view. A helper claims a job over a token-protected local API and must report it done. Optional backlog feeder from the Claude to-do list (off by default). TEST MODE by default: the line is kept, nothing is handed out.

ui.title: Work
ui.purpose: Shows the list of jobs for Claude and when they run.
